description: Run IgniteOnly💥 on a verified NudgeOnly bridge result or deterministic evidence. Emits a compact public worker wake packet only when safety gates pass.

bridge_id.description: Optional trusted bridge ID, such as nudgebridge_<hash>.

painpoint_detected.description: Whether trusted evidence found a painpoint.

painpoint_type.description: stale_ack, duplicate_wake, unclear_owner, noisy_thread, missing_proof, dormant_worker, or none.

request.description: Optional receipt request with worker, expected_receipt, verifier, and receipt_line.

source_id.description: Optional upstream event, dispatch, PR, issue, or wake identifier.

target.description: Human target label such as PR #706, issue #706, or a dispatch ID.

verified.description: True only when a trusted deterministic verifier has checked the evidence.

verifier_status.description: Optional verifier status such as passed, verified, confirmed, wakepass_pass, proof_checked, or ack_checked.

name: igniteonly_api
